name: @magus/agents
description: The guard-hook templates a magus workspace installs into an agent host, kept beside the guide that documents them (docs/guides/integrations/agents.md). Ships NO runtime code: the shell templates are copied into a host's hook config and the OpenCode plugin is loaded from source by OpenCode's own Bun runtime. devDependencies are the gates and one generator - @opencode-ai/plugin for the Plugin type, bun-types for Bun.spawn, and @cursor/sdk plus zod-to-json-schema for cursor-schemas.ts, which emits testdata/hosts/cursor/generated from Cursor's own published zod. None of it is bundled anywhere. pnpm (pinned in mise.toml), NOT npm; pnpm-workspace.yaml's minimumReleaseAge is the supply-chain guard.
